_README: ESTIMATES — NOT OFFICIAL TARIFFS. Replace before relying on these.
Bus fares in Sri Lanka are set by the National Transport Commission on a
stage-based system; rail fares are set by Sri Lanka Railways by distance
and class. Neither publishes a machine-readable feed, so this file models
them as a minimum fare covering an initial distance band plus a per-km
rate beyond it, with a multiplier per comfort class.
The rates below are plausible placeholders chosen to produce realistic
magnitudes, NOT transcribed from a published tariff. Verify against the
current NTC and SLR schedules, then update the rates and set `verified`
to true. While it is false the UI shows a ±uncertainty margin on every
figure and flags them as unverified.
To update: change the numbers here only. No code changes required.
